buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses A. Instructions to Bidders 1. The bidders are requested to quote the DAVP rates only. Further, in case the DAVP rates are not applica

ble to any newspaper, the participating bidder(s) shall submit a declaration to this effect on the letterhead of the concerned newspaper company. 2. The bidders shall upload the price breakup only with the Financial Bid. 3.The bidder shall upload proof of the applicable DAVP rates, wherever applicable, in respect of all editions in support of the quoted prices for all editions along with the Technical Bid. 4.The date of publication of the advertisement shall be communicated separately to the vendor finalized fo r award of the contract/order. B. Payment Terms 1. Payment shall be restricted to the applicable DAVP rates prevailing as on the date of publication of the a dvertisement, in respect of newspapers for which DAVP rates are applicable. 2. For claiming payment, the bidder shall submit a proper GeM invoice, proof of publication (in original) of t he advertisement in all editions, and a copy of the DAVP rates issued by the Central Bureau of Communicat ion , showing the rates applicable to the respective editions and valid as on the date of publication of the a dvertisement. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Gati Shakti Vishwavidyalaya payable at Vadodara .
